name: archicad-mcp
description: Delivery-readiness QA and full API access for a running Archicad 29 model
long_description:
Connects Claude to a **running Archicad 29** instance over the built-in JSON API.

- **Delivery-readiness QA.** Your office standards, written as YAML rules and run against the open model. Returns pass/fail, a score, and the GUIDs of the elements that failed.
- **Full API access.** Curated tools for querying, editing, and creating elements, plus a gateway to every official JSON API and Tapir command.

Archicad must be running with a project open; there is nothing to start on the Archicad side, because its JSON API listens whenever a project is open. The [Tapir add-on](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/releases) is optional but recommended, and is required for element creation, issues, IFC checks, highlighting, and publishing.

> **Save before you read properties.** `GetPropertyValuesOfElements` can crash Archicad 29, even for a single property on a single element, taking unsaved work with it. This is an Archicad-side fault this server can trigger but cannot prevent. See the documentation link for details.

**Updating:** install the newest `.mcpb` from the [releases page](https://github.com/alesdev88/Archicad-MCP/releases) over this one, then confirm the Office rules folder field is still set.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: 'full' exposes everything: QA, element tools, and the API gateway. 'verdicts' exposes only the 8 QA tools and keeps the project name out of what the model sees.

rules_dir.title: Office rules folder
rules_dir.description: Folder of YAML rule files holding your office standards. Keep it outside the repository. Leave empty to load the bundled example rules.

max_property_elements.title: Property-read element ceiling
max_property_elements.description: Refuse any property read spanning more elements than this. Blast-radius control for the Archicad property-read crash, not a fix for it. Lower is safer.

tools.name: list_instances
tools.description: List running Archicad instances: port, version, open project, Tapir availability. Call this first.

tools.name: get_model_summary
tools.description: Aggregate element counts by type, optionally by layer and story.

tools.name: list_rules
tools.description: List the loaded QA rules and any rule files that were rejected.

tools.name: run_rule
tools.description: Run one QA rule against the open model.

tools.name: audit_delivery_readiness
tools.description: Run the full rule set and return a score plus failing element GUIDs.

tools.name: verify_ifc_export_readiness
tools.description: Check the model against IFC delivery requirements.

tools.name: highlight_failures
tools.description: Highlight failing elements in Archicad.

tools.name: create_issues_from_failures
tools.description: Turn rule failures into Archicad issues.

tools.name: query_elements
tools.description: Query elements by type, layer, story, or current selection.

tools.name: get_element_data
tools.description: Read properties and classifications for specific elements.

tools.name: set_element_data
tools.description: Write property values to elements. Dry-run by default.

tools.name: create_elements
tools.description: Create walls, slabs, columns, beams, and objects. Dry-run by default.

tools.name: move_elements
tools.description: Move elements. Dry-run by default and requires confirm=true.

tools.name: delete_elements
tools.description: Delete elements. Dry-run by default and requires confirm=true.

tools.name: manage_selection
tools.description: Read or change the current selection in Archicad.

tools.name: get_project_info
tools.description: Project name, location, stories, and Teamwork state.

tools.name: list_attributes
tools.description: List layers, materials, composites, profiles, and other attributes.

tools.name: manage_issues
tools.description: List, create, and comment on Archicad issues.

tools.name: publish
tools.description: Run a publisher set.

tools.name: read_schedule_scheme
tools.description: Read an exported Scheme Settings XML file and explain what it does.

tools.name: edit_schedule_scheme
tools.description: Apply a YAML spec to an exported schedule scheme XML.

tools.name: validate_schedule_scheme
tools.description: Check a scheme's bindings against the open project.

tools.name: list_api_commands
tools.description: Catalog of every official JSON API and Tapir command.

tools.name: describe_api_command
tools.description: Full description and input schema for one API command.

tools.name: execute_api_command
tools.description: Execute any Archicad API command by name.
